value.rationale: The exact sixteen-sample sign reversal is a nontrivial local-vs-global dependence boundary in Pareto geometry; the disjoint-label interaction stays negative in all product-space dimensions. This sharp decomposition distinguishes a local edge touching a frontier point from an edge between other observations while aggregate comparability remains negatively correlated with skyline size, a natural baseline for random partial-order and skyline statistics.
